# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to determine from a sample the nature of a medicine or poison
including origins, purity, general value, effect, plus type and antidote (if
any) in the case of poisons.
@@ 2
Caster produces one dose of a medication which acts as an analgesic, providing
temporary relief from minor muscular pain (i.e., allowing the beneficiary to
ignore any one penalty of -10 or less due to muscular pain). The effects will
last ten minutes per level of the caster.
@@ 3
Caster produces one dose of a medication which will temporarily alleviate one
symptom of a minor ailment or illness (determined at time of casting).
Examples include alleviating the queasiness and vertigo associated with
nausea, alleviating sneezing, rashes, watery eyes etc. associated with an
allergic reaction (because of pollen, animal hair, etc.), reducing a fever by
one degree per level of the caster etc. The effects will last ten minutes per
level of the caster.
@@ 4
Caster produces one dose of a medication which acts as an anesthetic, inducing
unconsciousness, stupor, or insensitivity to pain (rendering the patient
unable to act). The effects will last ten minutes per level of the caster.
@@ 5
Caster produces one dose of a medication which will reduce the effects of an
infection or parasitic infestation,, killing bacteria, viruses, or parasites
on contact. The effects will last thirty minutes per level of the caster.
@@ 6
Caster produces one dose of an antidote to one specific poison (of 10th level
or less). The specific poison must be specified at time of casting. Damage
already sustained is not cured. This spell has its failure chance raised by 1
per level of the poison.
@@ 7
Caster produces one dose of a medication which will either render the target
fertile or infertile. A fertility medication will ensure conception will
occur, whereas an infertility medication will act as a contraceptive. The
effects will last one day per level of the caster.
@@ 8
Caster produces a medication which will cure any one disease (of 10th level or
less). The specific disease must be specified at time of casting. The recovery
period is one day. Damage already sustained is not cured. This spell has its
failure chance raised by 1 per level of the disease.
@@ 9
Caster produces a medication which will heal 3d10 concussion hits.
@@ 10
Caster produces a medication which will stop any blood loss from one wound.
@@ 11
Caster produces a physick which will heal any one area of skin damage
(scarring, burn, etc.). The recovery period is up to an hour (depending on the
severity of the injury).
@@ 12
Caster produces a medication which will repair damaged cartilage. The recovery
period is one day.
@@ 13
Caster produces a physick which will heal any hair or nail loss or damage. The
recovery period is one day.
@@ 14
Caster produces a physick which will repair a damaged muscle. The recovery
period is up to 10 hours dependent on the severity of the injury.
@@ 15
Caster produces a physick which will repair a damaged tendon. The recovery
period is up to 10 hours dependent on the severity of the injury.
@@ 16
Caster produces a medication which will repair a damaged, broken (simple or
compound fractures) or shattered bone (but not joints). The recovery period is
up to 10 days dependent on the severity of the damage (e.g., a simple fracture
would take one day, a shattered bone ten days to heal).
@@ 17
As Lesser Antidote, except the poison can be any level.
@@ 18
As Lesser Disease Curative, except the disease can be of any level.
@@ 19
Caster produces a medicine which repairs a damaged nerve. The recovery period
is one day.
@@ 20
Caster produces a medication which will repair a damaged, broken (simple or
compound fracture) or shattered joint. The recovery period is up to 10 days
dependent on the severity of the damage (e.g., a chipped joint would take one
day, a shattered joint ten days to heal).
@@ 25
Caster produces a medication which will halt any blood loss from one internal
injury.
@@ 30
Caster produces a physick which will repair any one damaged organ (except the
brain). The recovery period is up to 10 days dependent on the severity of the
injury.
@@ 50
Caster produces a physick which will heal any damage to the brain, restoring
memory loss and removing insanity (but not posssession or mental curses).The
recovery period is up to days dependent on the severity of the injury.
